plain_claim: For every toy program `e` and every two rule settings `R₁`, `R₂`: the action lists `run R₁ e` and `run R₂ e` are permutations of each other; `run R₁ e` contains no action twice; in `run R₁ e` the temporaries dropped (`dropTemps`: tag and borrow list of every `dropTemp`) are a permutation of the temporaries created (`mkTemps`: the same data of every `mkTemp`); and the actions other than temporary drops occur in the same order in `run R₁ e` and `run R₂ e`. `Commute` is word equality in the free monoid `List Ev`; it is not an independence relation on effects.
